We need an end to tech billionaires lobbying our government and CIA linked Palantir having defence and NHS data contracts. We need tech sovereignty with a new public internet server, not dependent on US surveillance monster Google. The UK should rejoin the EU, who have better data privacy and who have expressed a wish for a public owned tech sector of independent internet, cloud services, etc to give tech sovereignty, and lead on a new European alternative publicly owned tech sector with strict data privacy law at the heart of it to stop the mass surveillance operation the UK tech oligarchs have imposed on the internet users of the world.
We need a moratorium on hyper scaling, the massive data centres the tech companies insist we need for their large language models eg ChatGPT, but whose finances are shaky, opaque and circular and whose product has an unproven business case. These massive data centres should not have essential infrastructure planning status in the UK. There is no evidence they are essential infrastructure and plenty of evidence to the contrary. Our limited grid connections should be prioritised for the green energy projects we need for energy sovereignty and lower bills and not given over to these hyper scale data centres that will destroy the environment. We need a moratorium on all new hyper scale data centres in the UK and an independent review to produce a UK Sovereign Data Strategy.
Our country needs the undue influence of tech oligarchs out of our politics. We do not want to head down the route of the US where Trump is in the pocket of the tech oligarchs.
Reform is bank rolled by crypto and has Palantir's Thiel grooming his future leaders by James Orr (Cambridge University).
Clean up politics. Get the tech billionaires influence out of it and take back control.

records.title: Scotland Against Spin
records.bodyText:
ACTIVISTS battling massive pylon and transmission line developments across the Scottish Highlands – as well as expected huge incoming energy bills for homes and businesses – are challenging Prime Minister Andy Burnham’s new proposal for a UK Governmentcontrolled energy system called GB Grid. They demand a pause to projects and the launch of public inquiries.
“The devil will be in the details,” said Dan Bailey of Highland-based Better Cable Route on Burnham’s Labour Conference announcement to establish the new body alongside GB Energy in Aberdeen to speed up grid connections and increase competition among private sector operators.
“But we still hear far too little about the communities at the sharp end of the green transition,” Bailey added.
Better Cable Route relied on a September National Audit Office (NAO) report to describe what it termed “delays, chaos and secrecy”. This showed that some 64 of 88 grid projects won’t be delivered by the UK Government’s own 2030 clean power deadline. The National Electricity System Operator (Neso) dismissed such language as “misleading”.
THENATIONAL.SCOT Highland activists hit out at Andy Burnham’s GB Grid plan

Herald letters
THIS has to be one of the biggest (and cruellest) jokes perpetrated on the population of Great Britain in recent times.
Our country’s landscape and seascape have been desecrated by the construction of increasingly massive wind turbines, many of which do not operate for anything other than a fraction of the time they could be operational.
This is either because the wind
isn’t blowing sufficiently or because there is no means of storing the output.
Having had our countryside desecrated, we’re asked to pay to compensate the generators of wind produced electricity for their production which cannot be used, and have to use electricity produced by burning gas, most of which is imported, as our governments refuse to sanction the drilling of our offshore gas reserves. The result is that British businesses and consumers pay the highest price in Europe for the electricity they consume. A cost which increased by 4% yesterday, and is forecast by Cornwall Insight to increase further by a huge 16% in January 2027.
The situation is, frankly, quite ridiculous and completely untenable.
It demonstrates how incapable our governments are of running the country sensibly.
Bob Hamilton, Strathaven, South Lanarkshire.

If you have read the Officers report for the Glen Earrach Pumped Storage Hydro scheme, there is one obvious question – why has it recommended that the Council 'RAISE NO OBJECTION'?
Well, the Officer has scrutinised the consultation responses, which include:
Glen Urquhart Community Council objects 
Stratherrick and Foyers Community Council objects
Strathnairn Community Council objects 
Highland Council Ecology Officer objects 
Highland Council Landscape Officer objects 
NatureScot objects 
Jacobite Loch Ness Cruises objects
Ness District Salmon Fishery Board (NDSFB) objects
Royal Society for the Protection of Birds (RSPB) objects
The Woodland Trust objects
BugLife objects
Mountaineering Scotland objects
85% of public respondents object
Interestingly, the following responses were not covered in the Officers report:
Highlands Rewilding objects
Plantlife Scotland objects
Wild Trout Trust objects
Save Loch Ness objects
And thus, the Officer has recommended ‘RAISE NO OBJECTION’
Any questions?

Paderewski vessel at the Energy Yard at North Sutor. Voltaire Vessel is to the rear behind it. 
Wind turbine generator components for Doggar Bank 2 offshore wind project. 
The Energy Yard at North Sutor is located on the Nigg Peninsula in Easter Ross, Scotland, overlooking the entrance to the Cromarty Firth. 
It sits on the high ground of the North Sutor headland, right next to the historic, scheduled North Sutor Coastal Artillery Battery ruins. From this elevated coastal site, it directly overlooks the massive Nigg Energy Park fabrication yard situated at the base of the hill along the water.— in Nigg, Highland, United Kingdom.
